name: Tamara

wilderness_approach: silent interchangeable trees and stones (only what they are)
tiger print in the sand -> sign of the tiger's passage
marsh -> announces a vein of water
hibiscus flower -> announces the end of winter
statues_and_shields: lion -> sign that something has as its sign a lion
dolphin -> sign that something has as its sign a dolphin
tower -> sign that something has as its sign a tower
star -> sign that something has as its sign a star
prohibitions: forbidden to enter the alley with wagons
forbidden to urinate behind the kiosk
forbidden to fish with your pole from the bridge
post_exit_horizon: empty land stretching to the horizon beneath speeding clouds
sailing ship crystallized in wind-blown clouds

inner_arch: A thick coating of signs dictates everything you must think and forces you to repeat Tamara's discourse: every attempt to pry or peel beneath a signboard, building, idol, or stall-ware reveals never raw matter or concealed life, only another layer of prescriptive taxonomic labels, until you exit without having discovered the city itself—already projecting figures onto empty wind-blown clouds.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Xylographic woodcut & rubricated emblem-book street-corridor with recursive peelable plates, Royal Plate Guild copperplate cartography & architectural painting folio, and a gaze-dwell pareidolia cloud-augury horizon
anti_trude_vector.dom_signature_strategy: Custom xylographic custom elements (<tamara-emblem-book>, <wilderness-verge-stage>, <heraldic-corridor-stage>, <cantilever-sign-plate>, <peel-stratum-sheet>, <discourse-ledger-strip>, <horizon-augury-stage>, <archival-plates-folio>, <colophon-rubric>) and exclusively xylo-/tmr- prefixed CSS selectors to guarantee J_dom < 0.35 against all sibling cities.

tamara-signpainter.mission: Author window.TamaraSemioticCoat: handcrafted SVG woodcut plates for all 26 urban signs/shields/decrees/temples/edifices/stalls plus the infinite recursive peel engine where scraping beneath any object yields only deeper taxonomic discourse, never raw substance.

tamara-cloud-augur.mission: Author window.TamaraPareidoliaHorizon: (1) wilderness approach of mute trees & stones with the 3 natural signs (tiger print, marsh, hibiscus), and (2) post-exit open sky where procedural wind-blown clouds irresistibly crystallize into sailing ship, hand, and elephant wherever the gaze lingers.

tamara-weaver.mission: Compose standalone zero-dependency index.html wiring layers/semiotic_coat.js, layers/pareidolia_horizon.js, and an inspectable Map & City Plate folio drawer/tab referencing map.png and image.png (clean at 1280x800 & 390x844, full keyboard control, prefers-reduced-motion).

tamara-critic.mission: Audit title-masked Calvino recognition, all canonical signs/decrees/stalls/clouds, recursive non-material peel law, Royal Plate Guild map.png/map.svg + image.png & plate drawer wiring, standalone purity (zero external URLs, zero ../ imports), bespoke DOM/CSS signature, and responsive/accessibility compliance.

frozen_gates.HG-1_standalone_and_anti_trude: Zero http/https CDN links, zero ../ cross-city references, classic
frozen_gates.HG-2_canonical_completeness_and_masked_r: Unmistakably recognizable as Tamara with title masked; every canonical wilderness sign (3), signboard (4), shield/statue (4), prohibition (3), permission (3), temple attribute (3), unmarked building (5), stall ware (4), and cloud figure (3) interactive and legible.
frozen_gates.HG-3_inner_arch_and_ergonomics: Peeling/prying any urban element never exposes raw matter—only deeper taxonomic cross-references; lingering gaze on post-exit clouds snaps vapor into sailing ship, hand, and elephant; zero layout clip/overflow at 1280x800 and 390x844; full keyboard + prefers-reduced-motion support.
frozen_gates.HG-4_cartography_and_city_plate: Valid non-empty map.svg, map.png (>=1200px wide), and image.png (>=1200px wide) delivered by Royal Plate Guild and inspectable inside index.html via dedicated Map & City Plate drawer/tab.
